title: Test a proposed intake process before building software
request: Test whether customers and staff can complete a proposed guided intake process, revise it from evidence, and proceed to software only if supported.

required_map_nodes.question: Can representative users complete the proposed intake without staff rescue?
done_when: population and success threshold are set before the test
completion and rescue observations are recorded
limitations and falsifying evidence are retained

required_map_nodes.question: Does the scoped evidence justify entering the software route?
done_when: supported, revise, defer, or stop is explicitly recorded

decisions.question: What evidence threshold will count as support or failure?
decisions.consequence: The threshold controls whether the process is revised, stopped, or allowed into software design.

decisions.question: Does the scoped evidence justify entering the software route?
decisions.consequence: Proceeding commits further design effort; rejecting avoids building around an unsupported process.

decisions.question: Which software direction should the specification commit to?
decisions.consequence: The selected direction constrains the production experience and architecture.

route_expansion_when.condition: the experiment does not meet the agreed threshold but exposes a testable revision
the process claim is rejected or no longer worth pursuing
